issue.title: Remove stale symvision --epic-symbol exemption for closed bead sase-j3 (SnippetTriggerMatch)
issue.description: just lint fails at the _lint-symvision recipe on current master (verified via git stash on a clean tree -- identical failure, so this predates and is unrelated to my in-progress work): 'Error: --epic-symbol sase-j3(SnippetTriggerMatch): bead sase-j3 is closed. Remove this stale --epic-symbol entry and clean up the symbol.' Justfile:306 still passes --epic-symbol "sase-j3(SnippetTriggerMatch)" to the symvision invocation for closed bead sase-j3. Fix: remove that --epic-symbol entry from the Justfile and either delete the now-dead SnippetTriggerMatch symbol or otherwise resolve why symvision still flags it as unused/private-misused, per sase/memory/symvision.md's epic-whitelist guidance. This is the same recurring pattern as prior beads sase-bz/sase-by/sase-bu/sase-i0 (stale epic-symbol exemptions for other closed beads), just for a different bead/symbol. Discovered while running just check/just lint for an unrelated CLI-rename plan (sase/repos/plans/202608/stitch_create_migration.md) in workspace sase_13.

payload.entry: ALREADY FIXED on master: commit 9edf68079 (epic sase-j3 land agent, 2026-08-10T23:32:07Z) removed the '--epic-symbol "sase-j3(SnippetTriggerMatch)"' line from the Justfile _lint-symvision recipe and made SnippetTriggerMatch private (dropped from __all__). Verified from workspace sase_11 at HEAD 9c46891c5: 'just check' passes the 'lint (symvision)' stage clean. This bead was filed from workspace sase_13 whose HEAD was 62a4ddeb5, before the fix landed. Recommend closing as already-resolved. Reported independently as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP by phase bead sase-j8.4.
